battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while friendly non-Monster non-War Machine Gloomspite Gitz units are wholly within 3" of that terrain feature, they are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.

abilities.name: Git and Run
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gitmob unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that Gitmob unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
abilities.effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat range of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Spreading Loonacy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-Squig Moonclan or Spiderfang units in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move with the target. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Bouncing Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Squig unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Fang-filled Gobs, Massive Fang-filled Gobs or Huge Fang-filled Gobs for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Herd Healing
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Troggoth unit uses a Fight ability, after that ability has been resolved, Heal (D3) that unit.

abilities.name: Fight Another Day
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Loontouched
abilities.effect: If this unit is not a Wizard, it has Wizard (1). Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: The Clammy Hand
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Gloomspite Gitz unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Backstabber's Blade
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Leering Gitshield
abilities.effect: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Attack ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: The Clammy Cowl
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: The Hand of Gork
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gloomspite Gitz Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Spore Maws
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gloomspite Gitz Wizard to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Bad Portents
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gloomspite Gitz Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, nothing happens. On a 3-5, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face. On a 6, pick a new face of the Bad Moon for this battle round.

abilities.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Moon on the battlefield, pick a friendly Gloomspite Gitz Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Moon wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom

abilities.effect: Set up a Mork's Mighty Mushroom wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Lurid Light
abilities.effect: While friendly Gloomspite Gitz units are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation they are affected by all four faces of the Bad Moon (Grinnin', Scowlin', Sulkin', and Cacklin').

abilities.name: Mutating Spores
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of this Manifestation to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in that unit that are within 6" of this Manifestation. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Blessings of the Cauldron
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gloomspite Gitz Wizard within 1" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the target's power level until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Endless Terrors
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (4+) while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly Arachnarok units.

abilities.name: Wall Crawler
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can pass across terrain features as if it had Fly.
